requirement: Supported submission formats
implementation_notes: PDF, DOCX, TXT, PNG and JPG/JPEG accepted in current intake path.

requirement: Validate declared type, file signature, size and quarantine before parsing
implementation_notes: Byte limit and file signatures are checked; durable quarantine scanning is not implemented.

requirement: Preserve original binary and create immutable SHA-256 content versions
implementation_notes: Original bytes stored under opaque version key; SHA-256 and version number retained.

requirement: Extract text, tables and layout blocks with page/paragraph/offset provenance
implementation_notes: TXT, searchable PDF and DOCX paragraph/table extraction; full layout fidelity and scanned-PDF OCR absent.

requirement: OCR PNG/JPG and embedded visual text with region coordinates and extraction confidence
implementation_notes: PNG/JPG Tesseract word boxes and confidence; PDF/DOCX embedded image OCR absent.

requirement: Create owner-controlled, versioned Brand Knowledge Packs
implementation_notes: Static, versioned synthetic pack is loaded; owner-managed authoring, approval and publication lifecycle absent.

requirement: Represent facts with source, owner, status, scope, qualifiers and validity metadata
implementation_notes: Synthetic facts include source, owner/status, scope, qualifiers and validity; temporal replay and DB governance absent.

requirement: Represent policy clauses with severity, scope, owner, version and validity
implementation_notes: Static policy clauses and scopes are included; UI lifecycle and policy version governance absent.

requirement: Represent preferred terminology, prohibited variants and locale scope
implementation_notes: Configured preferred/prohibited terminology is checked; broader locale/scope management absent.

requirement: Represent tone rules and approved voice examples
implementation_notes: Configured phrase patterns are checked; no calibrated brand-voice model.

requirement: Maintain approved asset versions and match candidates to them
implementation_notes: Approved asset manifest is shown as evidence; automated logo matching is not implemented.

requirement: Resolve applicable truth against intended publication time and all relevant scope dimensions
implementation_notes: Current savings facts are checked against configured scope and publication validity; not a general temporal resolver.

requirement: Perform permission-aware hybrid lexical/vector retrieval with source ranking
implementation_notes: No hybrid lexical/vector retrieval, RRF or permission-aware pgvector retrieval.

requirement: Extract atomic structured claims while preserving qualifiers, units and source locations
implementation_notes: Narrow numeric-saving and selected quantified claim patterns; not general atomic claim extraction.

requirement: Run bounded specialist candidate checks for claims, terminology, tone and visual assets
implementation_notes: Bounded claim, terminology, tone and instruction-text checks; visual specialists are manual-review gates.

requirement: Adjudicate claims deterministically using approved evidence, precedence, scope, validity and sufficiency
implementation_notes: Deterministic adjudication for configured saving claims; broader source hierarchy/atomic-field proof absent.

requirement: Check terminology against approved and prohibited variants
implementation_notes: Configured preferred/prohibited variants checked.

requirement: Provide conservative basic tone checks and disclose their limits
implementation_notes: Configured voice patterns checked conservatively; no objective tone score.

requirement: Match logos/assets and show the exact image region and approved reference
implementation_notes: Visual asset identity is explicitly routed to manual review; no automated matching or region decision.

requirement: Measure configured palette/contrast rules and attach method and region
implementation_notes: Standards-grade contrast and palette measurement not automated; explicit visual review finding is created.

requirement: Store all specialist outputs in one canonical finding ledger
implementation_notes: Configured analysis findings persist in one review-linked ledger.

requirement: Keep confidence, extraction confidence, evidence sufficiency, verdict and severity as separate fields
implementation_notes: Verdict, severity, confidence, extraction confidence and evidence sufficiency are separate fields.

requirement: Every material finding links to exact content span/region and source record/version
implementation_notes: Findings persist exact spans/evidence or explicit no-span states; the review stores a full Knowledge Pack JSON snapshot and SHA-256 fingerprint. Visual asset matching remains a manual-review gate.

requirement: Generate minimal, purpose-preserving correction candidates with visible rationale
implementation_notes: Rule-backed TXT alternatives exist; broader intent-preservation rubric and multi-alternative generator absent.

requirement: Bind patches to base content hash and exact offsets/regions; invalidate stale patches
implementation_notes: TXT patch binds base hash and offsets; accepted patch generates new immutable version.

requirement: Run affected and neighbouring checks after a correction; block regressions
implementation_notes: Accepted TXT patch triggers a fresh full review; dedicated regression diff/gating UI is absent.

requirement: Support explicit review states, assignments, comments and request-changes path
implementation_notes: Request-changes and decision history exist; assignments, comments and collaboration tools absent.

requirement: Allow only authorised humans to approve, reject or reasoned-override an exact content version
implementation_notes: Role-gated decisions bind exact review content hash; override requires elevated role and reason.

requirement: Create immutable audit receipts binding reviewer, timestamp, content hash, pack/policy and evidence snapshot
implementation_notes: Audit events retain actor/action/hash; review records now bind content hash
column11: Knowledge Pack snapshot hash/full snapshot and analysis-rule version; signed receipt and DB-enforced append-only ledger remain future work.

requirement: Run durable idempotent jobs with leases, retry budgets and explicit failure states
implementation_notes: Review work is synchronous; no durable queue, leases, idempotent worker/retry orchestration.

requirement: Stream progress with reconnect/replay and polling fallback
implementation_notes: No SSE progress, reconnect/replay or polling job state.

requirement: Cluster recurring issues, overrides, stale facts and impacted reviews
implementation_notes: No Impact Radar clustering or impacted-review graph.

requirement: Propose policy clarification but require Brand Owner approval; never mutate policy autonomously
implementation_notes: Policy clarification workflow is not implemented.

requirement: Enforce tenant/brand scope and default-deny authorization before retrieving files or evidence
implementation_notes: Creator ownership and role checks exist in the single demo workspace; tenant isolation/RLS and object-store grants absent.

requirement: Maintain provider purpose/version/licence/data handling/retention/egress/fallback/cost disclosures
implementation_notes: Provider inventory documents local Tesseract and no hosted LLM/provider; operational provider governance UI absent.

requirement: Avoid logging raw confidential content, private prompts or unrestricted storage paths
implementation_notes: Structured safe error responses and no raw-content logging by default; complete telemetry/redaction review remains.

requirement: Provide deterministic/mock analysis and a cached demo pack so live provider calls are not required for demo success
implementation_notes: Deterministic local analysis and static synthetic pack support demos without hosted provider calls.

requirement: Maintain unit, integration, contract, E2E, security and evaluation tests with a labelled golden set
implementation_notes: Unit/integration suite and labelled golden set exist; contract/E2E/CI/security coverage is incomplete.

requirement: Preserve historical review results when content, policy, model or prompt versions change
implementation_notes: Historical content versions/reviews/decisions are exposed through the revision-history API; each review persists its exact Knowledge Pack snapshot/hash and analysis-rule version. Provider/model replay is not applicable to the current no-hosted-LLM MVP.

requirement: Show parse warnings, low-confidence OCR, stale data and provider outages as explicit states
implementation_notes: Parse warnings, low OCR and stale facts are explicit; provider-outage state is not connected to a live provider.
